articles.summary: Alphatec Holdings, Inc. (Nasdaq: ATEC) (“ATEC”), a provider of innovative solutions dedicated to revolutionizing the approach to spine surgery, today announced with great sadness that Jeffrey P. Rydin, a valued member of its Board of Directors, has passed away at age 59, following a lengthy illness. Mr. Rydin enjoyed nearly three decades of experience in the medical device and healthcare industries, including senior sales leadership roles at Ellipse Technologies, Inc., NuVasive, Inc., and DePuy
articles.title: ATEC Mourns Passing of Board Member Jeffrey P. Rydin
